mapper.select: SELECT receipt.id FROM contract_receipt receipt LEFT JOIN contract_base_info base ON receipt.contract_id = base.id WHERE base.contract_status IN ("START_RENT", "SETTLE") ORDER BY receipt.create_time DESC

SELECT a.id AS receiptId, IFNULL(d.overdueType,'NOT_OVERDUE') AS overdueType, a.receipt_code, c.client_name, b.proj_name, b.contract_code, b.contract_status, b.income_confirm_type, b.risk_control_industry_classify AS riskControlIndustryClassify, b.proj_sponsor_user_id AS sponsorUserId, bu.user_name AS sponsorUserName, b.biz_dept_id AS belongDeptId, bo.name AS belongDeptName, d.overdueStartTime AS overdueStartTime, a.receipt_start_date AS startRentTime FROM contract_receipt a LEFT JOIN contract_base_info b ON b.id = a.contract_id LEFT JOIN client c ON c.id = b.client_id LEFT JOIN bifrost_user bu ON b.proj_sponsor_user_id = bu.id LEFT JOIN bifrost_org bo ON b.biz_dept_id = bo.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT receipt_id, 'OVERDUE' AS overdueType, min(plan_collection_date) AS overdueStartTime FROM collection_base_info WHERE cash_flow_item = 'RENT' AND phase > 0 AND plan_collection_date < NOW() AND plan_collection_amount > collection_amount GROUP BY receipt_id ) d ON d.receipt_id = a.id JOIN ( SELECT receipt_id FROM contract_income_sharing WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY receipt_id ) s ON a.id = s.receipt_id
b.contract_status IN ('START_RENT', 'SETTLE')
AND c.id = #{query.clientId}
AND b.proj_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.projName} ,'%')
AND b.contract_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.contractCode}, '%')
AND a.receipt_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.receiptCode} ,'%')
AND b.contract_status = #{query.contractStatus}
AND d.overdueType is not null
AND d.overdueType is null
ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
